_note: Resume help near Hill AFB. Free services are listed first, then paid local professionals. Listing is not an endorsement and nobody pays to be listed. Every entry needs a sourceUrl (internal, never shown). Review flags live in RESOURCES-REVIEW.md.

resources.name: Hill AFB Military & Family Readiness Center
resources.description: Free one-on-one resume reviews, federal resume help, the Transition Assistance Program (TAP) and spouse employment help.
resources.who: Service members, spouses, retirees and others with base access

resources.name: Workforce Services – Clearfield Employment Center
resources.description: Utah's state job center: job coaching, resume and interview help, and workshops such as the two-page federal resume class.

resources.name: Workforce Services – Ogden Employment Center
resources.description: Utah's state job center in downtown Ogden: job coaching, job search workshops, and resume and interview help.

resources.name: Workforce Services Veteran & Military Employment
resources.description: Veteran employment representatives and free live online workshops on civilian resumes that translate military experience.
resources.who: Veterans, service members and military spouses

resources.name: Weber State University Career Services
resources.description: Resume and interview help, career mentoring and career fairs for Weber State students and alumni.

resources.name: Davis Tech Career Placement Services
resources.description: Appointments and walk-in help creating and reviewing resumes and cover letters, plus interview practice and LinkedIn help.
resources.who: Davis Technical College students and graduates

resources.name: Ogden-Weber Tech Student Success Center
resources.description: Career services specialists review resumes, run interview practice and help with the OTECH job board.
resources.who: Ogden-Weber Technical College students and graduates

resources.name: Empire Resume
resources.description: Ogden-area resume writing service: resumes, cover letters and LinkedIn profiles, including military and federal resumes.

resources.name: Notus Human Capital
resources.description: Davis County career management and outplacement firm offering resume services and career counseling.
